source_evidence: Microsoft Customer Voice projects are connected to a selected environment and survey responses are stored in that same environment.

Customer Voice supports creating projects in the selected environment and copying projects across environments; CV-02 used fresh production-connected JM1-Core project creation rather than custom migration tooling.
strategy: Create/configure production Customer Voice projects directly in JM1-Core, capture Customer Voice-hosted anonymous public URLs, bind production websites, submit controlled public responses, verify Dataverse response storage.
